A curse is rarely born from pure malice; it is usually love, twisted by grief. We bleed our unspoken regrets into the world until our sorrows gain teeth, forgetting that the most inescapable Domain Expansion isn't built with cursed energy—it is the inner hell we construct out of our own unforgiven past.
